svg.title: Memory leaks
svg.desc: A playback service keeps a sessions map, and sessions from swiped away apps are never deleted, so the map fills up. Its memory graph is a sawtooth whose floor rises after every garbage collection, until it hits the 1.5 GB limit, the container is killed for using too much memory, and it restarts with an empty map.
svg.text: swiped away apps never send stop
Every GC drops back, but the floor keeps rising until the container is killed.
